# Check catalog

Every check cites the section of the MCP specification it enforces. `error` checks enforce a MUST and fail the run; `warn` checks enforce a SHOULD or flag a heuristic; `info` checks are advice. Crashes and hangs fail the run whatever the check's severity.

## Conformance (CONF)

|---|---|---|---|

| [CONF-002](CONF-002.md) | error | modern era, stdio, http | Requests missing required _meta fields are rejected with -32602 |
| [CONF-003](CONF-003.md) | error | modern era, stdio, http | Unsupported protocol version returns -32022 with data.supported |
| [CONF-004](CONF-004.md) | error | modern era, stdio, http | Every result carries resultType |
| [CONF-005](CONF-005.md) | error | both eras, stdio, http | Request ids: null is rejected and responses echo the id exactly |
| [CONF-006](CONF-006.md) | error | modern era, http | HTTP headers that disagree with the body are rejected with -32020 |
| [CONF-007](CONF-007.md) | error | both eras, http | Origin header is validated on Streamable HTTP |
| [CONF-008](CONF-008.md) | info | both eras, stdio, http | Unknown tools get a JSON-RPC error, not a tool result |
| [CONF-009](CONF-009.md) | error | modern era, stdio, http | Undeclared client capabilities are never relied on |

| [CONF-017](CONF-017.md) | warn | modern era, stdio, http | Results identify the server in _meta serverInfo |

## Schema fuzzing (FUZZ)

| ID | Severity | Applies to | Check |
|---|---|---|---|
| [FUZZ-001](FUZZ-001.md) | error | both eras, stdio, http | Fuzzed tool arguments never crash the server or go unanswered |
| [FUZZ-002](FUZZ-002.md) | error | both eras, stdio, http | Invalid tool arguments are rejected cleanly, not with an internal error |
| [FUZZ-003](FUZZ-003.md) | warn | both eras, stdio, http | Invalid tool arguments are not accepted as a success |
| [FUZZ-004](FUZZ-004.md) | warn | both eras, stdio, http | Schema-valid tool arguments are not rejected as invalid params |

## Robustness (ROB)

| ID | Severity | Applies to | Check |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ROB-001](ROB-001.md) | warn | both eras, stdio, http | Malformed JSON gets a -32700 Parse error |
| [ROB-002](ROB-002.md) | warn | both eras, stdio, http | Invalid JSON-RPC envelopes are rejected, not executed |
| [ROB-003](ROB-003.md) | error | both eras, stdio, http | Unknown methods get -32601 Method not found |
| [ROB-004](ROB-004.md) | warn | both eras, stdio, http | tools/call with non-object arguments is rejected without an internal error |
| [ROB-005](ROB-005.md) | error | both eras, stdio, http | 1 MB and 10 MB requests are answered or rejected, never dropped |
| [ROB-006](ROB-006.md) | error | both eras, stdio, http | Cancellation is handled gracefully |
| [ROB-007](ROB-007.md) | error | both eras, stdio, http | Concurrent requests each get their own response |
